rule.description: A class accumulates the whole request pipeline in one owner: at least 24 effective public methods (own plus same-package inherited), references to Google API endpoint builders from at least 2 distinct API families, ownership of the HTTP transport (declares a public request method or issues *.request(...) calls), at least 2 distinct credential-lifecycle tokens in its method bodies, and construction of Spreadsheet/Worksheet domain objects. Applied uniformly to every class defined in the gspread package.
rule.detected_relation: single class -> transport/session ownership + credential lifecycle + multi-family endpoint building + domain model production
rule.detector: Pylint plugin (g001_checker.py) loaded with --load-plugins, message symbol g001-responsibility-sink-class (W9901), AST analysis over astroid

checks.description: Detect a single class that simultaneously owns the transport (inherited request machinery plus a composed transport instance), the credential lifecycle (interactive flows, file persistence, format conversion, login factories), endpoint building for more than one Google API family, and construction of the spreadsheet aggregates it coordinates.
checks.detected_relation: single class -> transport/session ownership + credential lifecycle + multi-family endpoint building + domain model production
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: One class becomes the only owner of every stage of making an API call: obtaining and storing credentials, converting them, sending the request, building the URLs, and producing the domain objects. The reported surface counts own methods plus public methods inherited from classes defined in the same package, so attempts to hide parts of the surface in a base class do not change the result.

matches.evidence: class gspread.client.Client inherits the package HTTP transport (owning its request machinery and session state) while still constructing a second composed transport instance in __init__ (entry E2); it absorbs the credential lifecycle as class-level members — config-directory and credential defaults, interactive local-server flow, authorized-user file load/store, oauth2client->google-auth conversion helpers (entries E3-E9) — plus login factories that construct the class itself (entries E10-E15), and adds by-key range accessors that build Sheets values URLs themselves (entries E16-E17) alongside its original spreadsheet/permissions coordination duties. The same relation is visible from the module side: the authentication module's functions survive only as forwarders into this class (entries E18-E27) and the utility module's credential conversion forwards into it through a deferred import (entry E28).

excluded.reason: Largest public surface in the clean tree (~96 methods) but a single responsibility: Sheet values work. One endpoint family, no transport machinery, no credential-lifecycle tokens, no aggregate construction. Satisfies only the surface facet.
Aggregate plus worksheet factory; one endpoint family, no credential-lifecycle tokens. Satisfies the surface and model-construction facets but not the conjunction.

Lives in the transport layer by design: owns the request method and references all three endpoint families, and therefore matching it would mislabel legitimate transport ownership. Fails the rule's surface facet (~20 public methods) and the model-construction facet; no credential-lifecycle concerns beyond authorized session creation shared with every transport.
Retry/backoff specialization of the transport; inherits the transport's methods and adds request-scheduling logic only. Adds no responsibility family, so it does not approach the conjunction.
Self-contained value record; no facet involvement.
Credential-conversion helpers live at module level in the clean tree; the rule scores classes, and no class in this module holds the pipeline stages.

Excluded in the CLEAN state by design: before the modeled accumulation the entry class owns only spreadsheet coordination (~20 effective public methods, one endpoint family, no credential tokens), so the clean tree returns zero matches. The rule reports the injected accumulation, not reasonable coordination work.
